latest_release.name: OpenIDEA v0.1.42
latest_release.body:
OpenIDEA 0.1.42 adds a New Project wizard with 38 generators for mainstream languages and frameworks, a JVM Memory view and heap snapshots in the debugger, Compile File for Java, rewriting of pushed Git history, built-in Qoder agents, and a What's New page after updates.

### Download

**Remote development:** `openidea-server` for [Linux x86-64](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.42/openidea-server-linux-x86_64.gz) · [Linux ARM64](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.42/openidea-server-linux-aarch64.gz) · [macOS x86-64](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.42/openidea-server-macos-x86_64.gz) · [macOS ARM64](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.42/openidea-server-macos-aarch64.gz), each with a `.sha256` file.

**Already installed?** OpenIDEA updates itself: use **Check for Updates**.

## What's new

### New Project
- **File › New Project** offers 38 generators grouped by language: Java, Spring Boot, Quarkus, Micronaut, Kotlin, Ktor, Scala, Python (Django, FastAPI, Flask), Node (Vite, Next.js, Nuxt, Angular, SvelteKit, Astro, NestJS, Express), Go, Rust, C/C++, Zig, .NET, PHP (Laravel, Symfony), Ruby on Rails, Dart/Flutter, Swift, Elixir/Phoenix, Haskell, static website and empty projects.
- Forms come from each generator, including Spring Initializr, code.quarkus.io and Micronaut Launch options; missing toolchains show install hints, progress streams in the dialog, and the project is built in a staging folder and opened only on success. Also on the Welcome screen and the title bar project menu.

### Run and debug
- **Memory** tab for JVM debug sessions: loaded classes with instance counts, sizes and deltas between refreshes; while paused, a class's instances, their fields and referrers.
- **Heap snapshots**: capture one from a debugged JVM or open an `.hprof` file, then browse classes with shallow and retained sizes, biggest objects, dominators, the path to a GC root, and compare two snapshots.
- **Compile File** for a single Java source, resolving the rest of its module; Maven builds are skipped when nothing changed, and run again when their output folders were deleted. Rebuild builds Maven modules through Maven.
- Debug Maven tests from the gutter; Gradle resources are processed before launches from the language server's classpath; the Run console uses the terminal f

detail.readme:
The IDE you know, rebuilt in Rust.

Download  ·  Docs  ·  Benchmark  ·  Plugins  ·  Community  ·  Sponsor

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/234dd54c-1255-4b3a-b35c-533d78d737c0 OpenIDEA brings the IntelliJ IDEA way of working — its keymap, its tool windows, its search-everything habits — to a native app with a Rust core. Editor, code insight, debugger, Git, terminal, database and HTTP clients, for 60+ languages. Builds for macOS, Windows and Linux. ## Benchmark Opening [freqtrade](https://github.com/freqtrade/freqtrade) (Python, ~770 files) with warm caches, median of 5 runs: | | OpenIDEA | IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.3 | | --------------------------- | ----------------- | ---------------------- | | Window with the project | **0.9 s** | 3.1 s | | Ready (CPU settled) | **1.1 s** | 13.2 s | | Memory (USS, all processes) | **169 MB** | 2011 MB | | CPU time until ready | **2.4 s** | 47.9 s | | Idle CPU | **4 %** of a core | 7 % of a core | | Quit | **0.3 s** | 5.9 s | A release build of OpenIDEA from `main` and IDEA with default settings and plugins, on Windows 11, 32-core AMD, 62 GB RAM. IDEA analyses Python more deeply, so "ready" doesn't mean the same work on both sides. Both are measured from the outside, the same way: see [`perf/compare`](perf/compare) to run it on your machine and projects. ## Plugins Plugins add actions, completion, quick fixes, tool windows, custom editors, themes, file icons and languages. They run as sandboxed WebAssembly components; themes, icon themes and languages need no code at all. Install them from Settings › Plugins, or start your own with `openidea-plugin new` — see [Writing OpenIDEA plugins](https://openidea.sh/en/plugins) and the [official plugins](plugins/official). The plugin API is still a preview. ## Community - [Discord](https://discord.gg/2Zy4yn7gP) — questions, feedback and release news. - WeChat group — scan to join: - Contributing: see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [contributor docs](https://openidea.sh/en/contribute/setup). ## Sponsor If OpenIDEA saves you time, you can support its development with Alipay or WeChat Pay.
